relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of the Nrf2/HO-1/carbon monoxide signaling pathway alone and/or in combination with the administration of specific analgesics is a valid strategy for the treatment of chronic pain

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: These effects are mainly produced by inhibition of oxidative stress, inflammation, glial activation, mitogen-activated protein kinases and/or phosphoinositide 3-kinase/phospho-protein kinase B phosphorylation in the peripheral and/or central nervous system

relationships.subject: HO-1
relationships.evidence_quote: these improvements are generally mediated by upregulation or prevention of the downregulation of µ-opioid receptors, δ-opioid receptors and/or cannabinoid 2 receptors in the setting of chronic pain

key_findings: Review: CO-RMs, HO-1 and Nrf2 activators relieve chronic pain and emotional comorbidities.
Their combination with opioids/cannabinoids improves analgesia via opioid and CB2 receptor preservation.
